# Higgsfield MCP
MCP server for [Higgsfield AI](https://higgsfield.ai) — generate images and videos with 16+ models through Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible client.
## Models
### Image
| Model | ID | Key Features |
|---|---|---|
| Nano Banana 2 | `nano-banana-2` | Fast, reference images (up to 16), 1k/2k/4k |
| Nano Banana 1 | `nano-banana-1` | Reference images, multi-ref |
| Soul v2 | `soul-v2` | Stylized, 720p/1080p/2k |
| OpenAI Hazel | `openai-hazel` | GPT-Image-1.5, low/medium/high/4k |
### Video
| Model | ID | Key Features |
|---|---|---|
| Kling 3.0 | `kling3` | Best quality, start/end frames, sound, 720p/1080p, std/pro |
| Kling 3.0 Omni FLF | `kling-o3-flf` | First/last frame control |
| Kling 2.6 | `kling2-6` | Balanced quality/cost |
| Kling 2.5 Turbo | `kling2-5-turbo` | Unlimited plan credits |
| Kling 2.1 | `kling` | Budget option |
| Grok Video | `grok` | xAI video model |
| Wan 2.6 | `wan2-6` | Open-source model |
| Wan 2.5 | `wan2-5-video` | 16:9 or 9:16 only |
| Seedance 1.5 | `seedance1-5` | ByteDance latest |
| Seedance Pro | `seedance` | ByteDance pro |
| Veo 3 | `veo3` | Google DeepMind |
| Sora 2 | `sora2-video` | OpenAI, 4/8/12s durations |
| Image2Video | `image2video` | Requires input image |
## Tools
| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `higgsfield_generate_image` | Generate images (returns job_id) |
| `higgsfield_generate_video` | Generate videos (returns job_id) |
| `higgsfield_wait_for_job` | Poll job(s) until complete, return result URLs |
| `higgsfield_get_job` | Check single job status (no polling) |
| `higgsfield_list_jobs` | List recent jobs with status and URLs |
| `higgsfield_cancel_job` | Cancel a running job |
| `higgsfield_check_cost` | Dry-run cost estimate for image generation |
| `higgsfield_get_credits` | Account balance and plan info |
| `higgsfield_list_models` | List all models with supported parameters |
| `higgsfield_video_pricing` | Static pricing reference |
| `higgsfield_browser_status` | Check Helm daemon connection |
| `higgsfield_refresh_token` | Manually set JWT token |
| `higgsfield_refresh_credentials` | Update Clerk session cookies for auto-refresh |
## Prerequisites
- [Bun](https://bun.sh) runtime
- A [Higgsfield AI](https://higgsfield.ai) account (with credits)
- [Helm daemon](https://github.com/nicholasgasior/helm) running with Chrome extension — used to get auth tokens from your browser session
- *(Optional)* [curl-impersonate](https://github.com/lwthiker/curl-impersonate) — improves reliabi

title: MCP, CLI & Integrations
snippet:
Beyond the web app, Higgsfield runs where your pipeline runs: an MCP server for chat agents, CLI + Skills for coding agents, and official plugins for design and video tools. None of them need an API key - they connect to your existing account and use your existing plan credits.
## Higgsfield MCP
MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets AI agents call Higgsfield directly. Connect once and generate images, videos, characters and audio from Claude or any MCP-compatible agent without opening the app. Server URL: **https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp**
1
Add the connector
In Claude (web or Desktop): Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, paste https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp and click Connect.
2
Authorize
Sign in to your Higgsfield account in the authorization window - if you're already logged in on higgsfield.ai, this step is automatic.
3
Verify
Ask 'What is my Higgsfield credit balance?' in a new conversation - Claude should call the MCP tools and return your account data.
Through MCP you can run image and video generation on all models, upscaling, background removal, expand/reframe, Kling Motion Control, Soul characters and reference Elements, audio (voiceover, voice cloning, dubbing), and check the credit balance. All MCP generations land in your Assets on higgsfield.ai, tagged with the MCP source.
Tip
Claude has no native credit cap - if you want control, instruct it at the start of a session: 'Before generating anything, tell me the credit cost and wait for my confirmation.'
## CLI + Skills
CLI + Skills is the integration for coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). Where MCP exposes all tools with free parameter selection, each CLI skill has a defined structure - less token overhead, consistent output.
1
Install skills
Run npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills - it pulls three skills: generate, soul and product-photoshoot.
2
Sign in
Run higgsfield auth login. No API key needed.
3
Generate
In your coding agent, call /higgsfield:generate or just say 'Generate an image with Higgsfield' - the agent picks the skill and runs it.
- **generate** - image and video from any Higgsfield model, up to 4K; the agent selects a model automatically or you specify one.
- **soul** - train a Soul character from photos; the skill handles upload, training and naming.
- **product-photoshoot** - turn a product link or images into studio-quality product shots and video ads.

# Higgsfield AI MCP Server
A [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server that provides access to [Higgsfield AI](https://higgsfield.ai)'s cinematic-grade image and video generation capabilities. Built with [FastMCP](https://github.com/jlowin/fastmcp).

## Features
- **Text-to-Image Generation**: Create high-quality images using the Soul model
- **Image-to-Video**: Convert static images into cinematic 5-second videos with motion presets
- **Character Consistency**: Create reusable character references for consistent appearance across generations
- **Style Presets**: Browse and apply cinematic style presets
- **Motion Library**: Access pre-designed motion effects for video generation
## Installation
### Prerequisites
- Python 3.10 or higher
- pip (Python package installer)
- Higgsfield AI account with API credentials ([Sign up](https://cloud.higgsfield.ai))
### Setup
1. **Clone or download this repository**
2. **Install dependencies** (choose one method):
**Option A: Using pip (recommended for simplicity)**
```
cd higgsfield_ai_mcp
pip install -r requirements.txt
```
**Option B: Using Poetry**
```
cd higgsfield_ai_mcp
poetry install
```
3. **Configure API credentials** (choose one method):
**Option A: Environment variables (recommended for .env file)**
```
cp .env.example .env
```
Edit `.env` and add your Higgsfield AI credentials:
```
HF_API_KEY=your-api-key-here
HF_SECRET=your-secret-key-here
```
**Option B: Command line arguments**
Pass credentials directly when running the server:
```
python -m higgsfield_mcp.server --api-key YOUR_KEY --secret YOUR_SECRET
```
Get your API keys from: [https://cloud.higgsfield.ai/api-keys](https://cloud.higgsfield.ai/api-keys)
## Usage
### Local Development & Testing
Test the server:
```
# Run directly with Python
python -m higgsfield_mcp.server
# Or with command line arguments
python -m higgsfield_mcp.server --api-key YOUR_KEY --secret YOUR_SECRET
# Run in development mode with auto-reload (if using Poetry)
poetry shell
fastmcp dev src/higgsfield_mcp/server.py
```

```
"higgsfield": {
"command": "python",

"-m",
"higgsfield_mcp.server"
],
"cwd": "/absolute/path/to/higgsfield_ai_mcp",
"env": {
"HF_API_KEY": "${HF_API_KEY}",
"HF_SECRET": "${HF_SECRET}"
}
}
}
}
```

```
# higgsfield-mcp-unified
A local-first [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server for [Higgsfield AI](https://higgsfield.ai/). It puts **85 models from the official Higgsfield API**: Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0 / O3 / Omni, Wan 3, Genjutsu, Cinema Studio 4, Soul, Marketing Studio, Recraft, Ideogram and more. Soul character training, webhooks, cost estimates and preset catalogs sit behind the same typed tool surface, which any MCP client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, …) can use. An opt-in experimental backend adds 34 consumer-app models such as Sora 2, Veo 3 and Nano Banana.

## Why this over the hosted MCP
The official hosted MCP (`mcp.higgsfield.ai`) runs on Higgsfield's servers behind OAuth. This one runs **on your machine** with your API key, and adds:
- **The full API catalog, typed.** Every documented endpoint has its parameters, enums, ranges and defaults, so the model picks valid values before spending credits.
- **Discovery that costs nothing.** `estimate_cost` prices a request, while `recommend_model`, `validate_params` and `preflight_check` work without running a generation.
- **Structured output.** Every tool returns a schema'd result (`outputSchema` + `structuredContent`), not an opaque blob.
- **Built-in reliability.**
- Every submit carries an idempotency key, so retries (backoff with jitter, plus a circuit breaker) never double-charge.
- Errors come back as typed cases: auth, out of credits, concurrency limit, bot challenge, network.
- **Webhooks and every output type.** It surfaces images, video, audio and the extra video/3D files (zip, mov, jsx, fbx, ply).
## Install
The package is [`higgsfield-mcp-unified`](https://pypi.org/project/higgsfield-mcp-unified/) on PyPI, and its command is `higgsfield-mcp`. With [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) there's nothing to install up front:
```
uvx --from higgsfield-mcp-unified higgsfield-mcp     # starts the stdio MCP server
```
Or install it with pip:
```
pip install higgsfield-mcp-unified
higgsfield-mcp
```
To run from source instead:
```
git clone https://github.com/Hikhakk/higgsfield-mcp-unified
cd higgsfield-mcp-unified
uv sync
uv run higgsfield-mcp
```
## Configure
Create an API key at [open.higgsfield.ai](https://open.higgsfield.ai) → **API keys**, then set:
```
export HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY=...        # key ID
export HIGGSFIELD_SECRET=...         # key secret

title: How do I connect Higgsfield to Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI agent?
snippet:
Higgsfield connects to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible agents, with no API key. In Claude, add a custom connector with the URL `https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp`. In ChatGPT, add the Higgsfield Plugin from the Plugins Directory. In Cursor, add Higgsfield from the marketplace. In Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes, the agent installs the Higgsfield CLI. An active paid subscription is required.
## What do I need before connecting?
An active Higgsfield subscription and an account in the AI agent: Claude (claude.ai or Claude Desktop), ChatGPT, Cursor, or any other MCP-compatible client. No API key or additional setup is needed.
## Which agents can I connect?
| Agent | How it connects |
|---|---|
| Claude (claude.ai and Claude Desktop) | Custom connector with the MCP server URL |
| ChatGPT | Official Higgsfield Plugin from the Plugins Directory |
| Cursor | Higgsfield from the marketplace |
| Claude Code, OpenClaw, Hermes | Higgsfield CLI, set up by the agent itself |
| Any other MCP-compatible client | MCP server URL in the agent's settings |
## How do I connect in Claude?
1. Open [claude.ai](http://claude.ai/) or Claude Desktop and go to **Settings** → **Connectors**.
2. Click **Add custom connector**.
3. Name it Higgsfield and paste the MCP server URL: `https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp`
4. Click **Connect**: a Higgsfield authorization window opens.
5. Sign in to your Higgsfield account and authorize. If you're already logged in on [higgsfield.ai](http://higgsfield.ai/), this step is automatic.
6. Return to Claude: the Higgsfield connector appears in your active connectors list.
## How do I connect in ChatGPT?
ChatGPT uses the official Higgsfield Plugin instead of a manual URL:
1. Open the Plugins Directory in ChatGPT, or go to [higgsfield.ai/mcp](https://higgsfield.ai/mcp) and select **Add Higgsfield plugin**.
2. Find Higgsfield and select **Add**.
3. Sign in to your Higgsfield account and authorize.

## How do I connect in Claude Code, OpenClaw, or Hermes?
These agents connect through the Higgsfield CLI, which the agent installs itself. Copy and send this message to your agent:
> “Set up Higgsfield for me so I can generate images and videos from here. 1. Install the CLI: run `npm i -g @higgsfield/cli`. 2. # Higgsfield MCP
MCP server for [Higgsfield AI](https://higgsfield.ai) — generate images and videos directly from Claude or any MCP-compatible client.
---
## Setup
**Node.js 18+ required.** Get your API keys at [https://cloud.higgsfield.ai/api-keys](https://cloud.higgsfield.ai/api-keys).
### Claude Desktop
Edit `%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json` (Windows) or `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` (macOS):
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"higgsfield": {
"command": "npx",
"args": ["-y", "higgsfield-mcp"],
"env": {
"HF_API_KEY": "your_api_key",
"HF_SECRET": "your_secret"
}
}
}
}
```
### Claude Code
```
claude mcp add higgsfield -- npx -y higgsfield-mcp
export HF_API_KEY=your_api_key
export HF_SECRET=your_secret
```
### 3. Get Your API Keys
1. Go to [https://cloud.higgsfield.ai/api-keys](https://cloud.higgsfield.ai/api-keys)
2. Create or copy your **API Key** and **Secret**
### 4. Connect to an MCP Client
#### Claude Desktop
Edit your Claude Desktop config:
- **macOS** — `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`
- **Windows** — `%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json`
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"higgsfield": {
"command": "npx",
"args": ["-y", "higgsfield-mcp"],
"env": {
"HF_API_KEY": "hf_xxxxxxxxxxxx",
"HF_SECRET": "sk_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}
}
}
}
```
Restart Claude Desktop after saving.
#### Claude Code (CLI)
```
claude mcp add higgsfield -- npx -y higgsfield-mcp
```
Then set your environment variables before running Claude Code:
```
export HF_API_KEY=hf_xxxxxxxxxxxx
export HF_SECRET=sk_xxxxxxxxxxxx
```
#### Cursor / VS Code
Add to your `.cursor/mcp.json` or `.vscode/mcp.json`:
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"higgsfield": {
"command": "npx",
"args": ["-y", "higgsfield-mcp"],
"env": {
"HF_API_KEY": "hf_xxxxxxxxxxxx",
"HF_SECRET": "sk_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}
}
}
}
```

## How Jobs Work
Tools return either a `job_set_id` or `request_id`. Poll the matching status tool until `completed`, then download the output URL. Results are kept for **7 days**.
```
generate_image(...)             → job_set_id  → get_generation_status(job_set_id)
generate_image_reve(...)        → request_id  → get_request_status(request_id)
generate_video_kling(...)       → request_id  → get_request_status(request_id)
```
All tools accept an optional `webhook_url` to receive a callback when the job finishes.

### Step 1: Install the MCP Server
From the `higgsfield-mcp` directory:
```
pip install -e .
```
Or install globally:
```
pip install higgsfield-mcp
```
### Step 2: Configure MCP in Your Project
Add to your project's `.mcp.json` file:
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"higgsfield": {
"command": "python",
"args": ["-m", "higgsfield_mcp.server"],
"env": {
"HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY": "your-api-key-uuid-here",
"HIGGSFIELD_SECRET": "your-secret-here"
}
}
}
}
```
**Or** if installed via pip, use the command directly:
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"higgsfield": {
"command": "higgsfield-mcp",
"env": {
"HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY": "your-api-key-uuid-here",
"HIGGSFIELD_SECRET": "your-secret-here"
}
}
}
}
```

```
List available MCP tools
```
You should see the Higgsfield tools listed:
- `mcp__higgsfield__generate_image_soul`
- `mcp__higgsfield__get_soul_styles`
- `mcp__higgsfield__generate_video_dop`
- etc.

### Option 1: Use Environment Variables
Create `.env` file in your project:
```
HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY=your-key
HIGGSFIELD_SECRET=your-secret
```
Then reference in `.mcp.json`:
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"higgsfield": {
"command": "higgsfield-mcp"
}
}
}
```
The server will automatically load from `.env`.
### Option 2: Direct Configuration (Recommended for Claude Code)
Put credentials directly in `.mcp.json` as shown in Step 2.
### Option 3: System Environment Variables
Export in your shell:
```
export HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY=your-key
export HIGGSFIELD_SECRET=your-secret
```
Then use simple config:
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"higgsfield": {
"command": "higgsfield-mcp"
}
}
}
```

### "MCP server not found"
Make sure the package is installed:
```
pip list | grep higgsfield
```
If not found:
```
pip install higgsfield-mcp
```
### "Invalid credentials"
Check your `.mcp.json` has the correct API key and secret:
- API key should be in UUID format
- No extra spaces or quotes in the values
- Both key and secret are required
Verify at: [https://platform.higgsfield.ai](https://platform.higgsfield.ai)

## MCP Tool Reference
All tools are prefixed with `mcp__higgsfield__`:
| Tool Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `generate_image_soul` | Generate images from text |
| `get_soul_styles` | List style presets |
| `generate_video_dop` | Animate images |
| `get_motions` | List motion presets |
| `generate_speech_video` | Create talking videos |
| `create_character` | Create character reference |
| `get_character` | Get character status |
| `delete_character` | Delete character |
| `get_job_status` | Check generation status |

# Higgsfield Unlimited MCP
A complete MCP server for [Higgsfield AI](https://higgsfield.ai) that calls the generation API in **unlimited mode**, bypassing the credit system used by the official Higgsfield MCP. Auth uses your existing browser session (Clerk JWT auto-refreshed every 4 minutes).
**What's covered:** image generation (32 models), video generation (31 models), audio (TTS), storyboards (multi-shot continuity), workspaces, media library, assets, favourites, generation history, account/plan info, job cancellation — everything the official Higgsfield MCP exposes, plus video, audio, storyboard, and cancel that the official MCP doesn't.
> Requires an active Higgsfield subscription with unlimited mode enabled.
---
## Quick Install
**Requirements:** Python 3.10+, [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)
```
pip install git+https://github.com/creativecgl/higgsfield-unlimited-mcp.git
```
Or with `uvx` (no install needed, runs ephemerally):
```
uvx --from git+https://github.com/creativecgl/higgsfield-unlimited-mcp.git higgsfield-unlimited-mcp
```
Then jump to Setup to wire up your credentials.
---
## Tools (31 total)
### Auth & account
| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `auth_status` | Verify Clerk credentials by fetching a fresh JWT. |
| `account_info` | Plan info, all credit balances, `has_unlim` flag. |
| `concurrent_state` | Concurrent-slot tier (4/8/12/16). |
| `queue_status` | In-process job registry snapshot. |

| `generate_image` | Single image — 32 models including nano-banana-2, flux-2, seedream-v4-5, openai-hazel, reve, z-image. Supports `input_files` for local-file auto-upload. |
| `generate_image_batch` | Queue many prompts; runs up to `max_concurrent` in parallel. |
| `generate_storyboard` | Multi-shot storyboard with character/style continuity (uses `nano-banana-2-shots` — Higgsfield's dedicated multi-shot endpoint).

### 1. Get your Higgsfield credentials (~2 min)
Open [https://higgsfield.ai](https://higgsfield.ai) in Chrome while logged in.
**`__client` cookie:**
1. Open DevTools (`Cmd+Option+I`)
2. Go to **Application** → **Cookies** → `https://higgsfield.ai`
3. Copy the value of the `__client` cookie
**Session ID:**
1. Open DevTools → **Console**
2. Run: `window.Clerk.session.id`
3. Copy the result — it starts with `sess_`
### 2. Install
```
pip install git+https://github.com/creativecgl/higgsfield-unlimited-mcp.git
```
To update later:
```
pip install --upgrade git+https://github.com/creativecgl/higgsfield-unlimited-mcp.git
```
### 3. Add
